title: Coast Mountain Landing Helicopter Tours (Depart SKY Hangar)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Prepare for an extraordinary adventure into the heart of British Columbia's rugged Coast Mountains, where stunning vistas and untouched wilderness await. Choose between a 45, 60, 75 or 105 minute experience. 

Your journey begins with a breathtaking flight over lush forests, towering peaks, and glacial-fed rivers. As you soar higher, the landscape unfolds beneath you, revealing panoramic views that stretch as far as the eye can see. The highlight of your tour awaits as we touch down in a remote and pristine location. Step out onto untouched terrain and immerse yourself in the serenity of nature. For 15 unforgettable minutes, you'll have the opportunity to explore, photograph, and connect with the wilderness like never before. 

 SINGLE PASSENGERS: We require a minimum of TWO purchased seats for any flight to depart. Our team will do their best to pair you up with other passengers. If you are the only passenger booked on a departure, SKY reserves the right to cancel your booking.
